thread.title: Canaccord Genuity Thinks Apple’s Stock is Going to Recover

author: Brian Anderson
title: Canaccord Genuity Thinks Apple’s Stock is Going to Recover
text:
Brian Anderson - January 30, 2019, 8:05 AM EDT SHARE ON:
In a report released today, Michael Walkley from Canaccord Genuity maintained a Buy rating on Apple ( AAPL ), with a price target of $185 . yesterday at $154.68, close to its 52-week low of $142.
 Walkley is a 5-star analyst with an average return of 10.5% and a 53.8% success rate. Walkley covers the Consumer Goods sector, focusing on stocks such as Digi International Inc, Sierra Wireless Inc, and BlackBerry Limited.
The word on The Street in general, suggests a Moderate Buy analyst consensus rating for Apple with a $183.75 average price target, which is a 18.8% upside from current levels. In a report issued on January 18, RBC Capital also maintained a Buy rating on the stock with a $185 price target.
See today’s analyst top recommended stocks >>
Apple’s market cap is currently $735.5B and has a P/E ratio of 13.03. The company has a Price to Book ratio of 6.86.
Based on the recent corporate insider activity of 58 insiders, corporate insider sentiment is positive on the stock. This means that over the past quarter there has been an increase of insiders buying their shares of AAPL in relation to earlier this year. Earlier this month, Albert Gore, a Director at AAPL bought 35,000 shares for a total of $507,850.
